overlay.definition: kernel-mass coverage times observation-point kernel-weighted basis mean; same 5 bases and 3 taus as duration
overlay.normalization: same full-window kernel mass as original duration
overlay.discrepancy: mean over labs with >=2 observations and positive coverage of abs(time-weighted mean - observation mean), using original standardized clipped values

protocol.description: independent expanded-coordinate factors; equal fresh initial function; fixed PM recipe
protocol.early_stop_rule: full 256 epochs; unchanged eICU E2 schedule
protocol.fusion_schedule: same native clock as input adapter
protocol.auxiliary_topology: removed; no auxiliary logits or loss
protocol.ablation_implementation: expand fresh K*d factors through feature_map to K*(d+3q) independent parameters
